title: Mastery of Corruption
summary: Defeat increasingly large groups of adventurer-like opponents.
overview: Defeat increasingly large groups of adventurer-like opponents.

phases.label: First wave
phases.description: Defeat the initial party of six class-based enemies.

phases.label: Second wave
phases.description: Collect the larger party and control its casters and healers.

phases.label: Final wave
phases.description: Defeat the largest party to complete the trial.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: The three waves grow from a small balanced party to a much larger force.
Assign control for healers and dangerous casters while tanks collect the melee enemies.
Expect class-specific tricks, including monk recovery and wizard positioning behavior.
Keep the fighting inside the trial area.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 2.
Opponent identities are selected from class-specific source tables; NPC links include only literal registered participants.
Primary NPC template ID remains unverified; npc_ids is intentionally empty.
